topic.title: 65 million views, 3,459 people in the stand
topic.claim: Free views are not fans, and football's opening week shows the same gap that influencer reach hides.
topic.behaviour: We leave a match running on the phone while doing something else, then count that as support for the sport. The stadium in Pune had 3,459 people.
topic.mechanism: Views are free for the viewer and easy to inflate with repeat watching. A ticket costs money and a trip, so it measures real interest.
topic.group: Sports fans and anyone who works with numbers on screens
topic.moment: You have a match open in a tab and haven't looked at it for twenty minutes.

turn.believed: A huge view count means a sport has arrived.
turn.actually: Views count attention that cost nothing; the stands count people who paid.

topic.feeling: Suspicious of big numbers I'm shown
topic.villain: A reach metric that counts a click the same as a commitment
topic.because: Leagues and sponsors earn from impressive reach numbers, so those get announced loudly. Attendance is harder to flatter, so it gets mentioned less.

proof.fact: The 2026-27 Indian Super League drew 65 million YouTube views and 52 million reach across its first five fixtures, and the page says views can include repeat watching. 3,459 attended Inter Kashi vs Kerala Blasters in Pune.

topic.payoff: Test: if it were not free, would you still have it open? That's your real fan count.
topic.send_to: The friend in marketing who quotes reach numbers as if they were sales.
real_details: 40,014 watched Kerala Blasters draw with Mumbai City in Kochi
about 91% of the opening audience watched on phones
One person has been trying to get Realme earbuds fixed under warranty since April, using calls, emails, a service centre, social media, the consumer helpline and an e-Jagriti complaint.
They say they explained the same issue to more than 50 people and it still isn't fixed.
The Consumer Commission told them they would have to show up in person for months to pursue it, so they gave up.
They wondered whether their dad, brother or grandfather would chase this for months, and said they probably wouldn't, which is why they then reached out to brands as a stranger.
A commenter called the post a marketing piece for the 7 brands that sent free goods, and another used the word 'Freebiefluencer'.
topic.news_peg: ISL 2026-27 opening-week viewership and attendance figures, reported 2026-11-09
topic.why_now: The season has just started and the first stand-versus-screen numbers are in.

score.why: Free views aren't fans, the same hidden reach gap the page keeps pointing at; the 'if it weren't free' test is clear.
